FRENCH MUNICIPAL POLICE.    Shanghai, November 14, 1933.
---
Political Section.
---

INTELLIGENCE REPORT No. 348/2.

Subject: Troupe of Bohemians Desiring to
         Proceed to Netherlands Indies.

Ref:     Letter No. 3260 from Netherlands
         Consul-General dated November 3, 1933.

A troupe of Bohemians under the management of
Georges Peris ( Pirez ) intends to proceed to the Netherlands
Indies to make an artistic tour.

The money for the expenses will be supplied by
Georges Peris alias Pirez, holder of American passport No. 6928
issued at Honolulu on March 25, 1932.

The troupe in question is composed of the following
persons:-

Georges Peris:    aged 22, manager.
**〔此处转录不清〕**
Antoine Peris:    aged 47, his father, holder of American
                  passport No. 6927 issued at Honolulu
                  on March 25, 1932.

Anne          :   his wife, aged 43, and their 4 children:
                  Irene aged 14, Jean aged 6 and Rose
                  aged 3.

Nicolas Minescos :  aged 36, his wife Anastasie aged 33, and
                    their daughter Pauline aged 13.

Elie Minescos :   aged 33, his wife Anne aged 30, and their
                  four children aged 10, 6, 3 and 1.

Jean Stanescos :  aged 37, his sons Alexis aged 20; Georges
                  aged 17 and Basile aged 3, his daughters
                  Pauline aged 16, Marie aged 14,
                  Alexandre aged 7 and Olga aged 5.

Pauline Yanoff :  aged 22.

In all 25 persons.

The Minescos and Stanescos and Miss Yanoff are Greek
subjects.

The Minescos and Stanescos families arrived in Shanghai
from the U. S. S. R. via Harbin in 1928.

During their sojourn in Shanghai, they have been
dancing and singing in various restaurants and cabarets such as

REPORT

Special Branch S. B. Registry.
Date November 14, 1933.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / For N. S. B. REGISTRY. / No. D / Date 14/11/33）

Subject (in full) Inquiries concerning troupe of performers named Pirez, Minescos
and Stanescos who desire to proceed to Netherlands India.

Made by D.S. Tilton Forwarded by [签名]

In accordance with instructions received, inquiries
have been made in connection with the information contained
in the attached letter from the Netherlands Consulate regarding
the troupe of 23 gypsy artists of the families of Pirez,
Stanescos and Minescos, of American and Greek nationality.
These persons who are residing together at No. 223 Route de
Sieyes, French Concession, have earned their living while in
Shanghai by giving performances as dancers, singers and
musicians under their leader George Pirez, and are engaged
in providing this class of entertainment at cabarets in the
French Concession such as the "Moulin Rouge", "Black Eyes",
"Kavkaz" and the "Alcazar".
Inquiries did not reveal that these persons are
interested in politics and there is nothing on record
at Municipal Police Headquarters concerning them.

[签名: Arthur George Tilton]
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

[批注: ref] Mr Yao.
Usual reply please.

主题（全称） 关于名为Pirez、Minescos和Stanescos的演艺团体欲前往荷属印度的查询。

由 D.S. Tilton 办理 转呈 [签名]

根据收到的指示，已就附上的荷兰领事馆来信中所载信息进行查询，该信涉及由Pirez、Stanescos和Minescos家族组成的23名吉普赛艺人团体，具有美国和希腊国籍。这些人共同居住在法租界Sieyes路223号，在上海期间，他们在首领George Pirez的带领下，以舞者、歌手和音乐家的身份表演谋生，并在法租界的歌舞厅如“红磨坊”、“黑眼”、“高加索”和“阿尔卡萨”（Alcazar）提供此类娱乐服务。
查询未发现这些人对政治感兴趣，警务处总部档案中也没有关于他们的记录。

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 3258.

SHANGHAI, 3rd November 1933.

（批：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE REGISTRY 5449 6 - 11 / 33）

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that I have received applications for visés for admission into Netherlands' India from a group of about 23 persons, who might be described as gipsies and who intend to give performances as dancers, acrobats and musicians in Netherlands' India.

They appear to be under the leadership of a certain George PIREZ, a coppersmith, born at Denver, Colorado, 15-6-1911, a USA citizen, holder of a passport issued by the Governor of Hawaii, Honolulu, 25-3-32, valid for 2 years, No. 6928. Pirez first stated that he intended to find work in a sugar factory for repairing machinery, but on being told that as a rule no visés are issued to persons who are looking for work, he stated that he would confine himself to giving performances, saying that he had sufficient money to manage everything. However the general appearance of his associates suggests that their means of subsistance are not very ample. Pirez stated that some of his kinsmen are already in Netherlands India, giving performances there.

Pirez' company consists of Antonio PIREZ, also a copper-smith, born at Phoenix, Arizone, 20-5-86, a USA citizen, holder of a passport issued by the Governor of Hawaii, Honolulu, 25-3-32, valid for two years, No. 6927, comprising also his wife Anna and his children Irene, John, Ely and Mary, resp. about 14, 11, 6 and 3 years of age.

Further there are: Nicolas Georg Minescos, an artist, born at Corfu, 56 years of age, of Greek nationality, holder of a Greek

（批：上海公共租界工部局警务处登记室 5449 6 - 11 / 33）

先生，

谨此通知您，我已收到一个约23人的团体申请进入荷属印度的签证，这些人可被描述为吉普赛人，他们打算在荷属印度作为舞者、杂技演员和音乐家进行表演。

他们似乎在一位名叫George PIREZ的人领导下，此人是一名铜匠，1911年6月15日出生于科罗拉多州丹佛市，美国公民，持有夏威夷总督于1932年3月25日在檀香山签发的护照，有效期两年，号码6928。Pirez最初声称他打算在糖厂找修理机器的工作，但当被告知通常不向寻找工作的人签发签证时，他表示将仅限于进行表演，并称他有足够的资金处理一切事务。然而，其同伴的总体外表表明他们的生计手段并不宽裕。Pirez称他的一些亲属已经在荷属印度，并在那里进行表演。

Pirez的剧团包括Antonio PIREZ，也是一名铜匠，1886年5月20日出生于亚利桑那州凤凰城，美国公民，持有夏威夷总督于1932年3月25日在檀香山签发的护照，有效期两年，号码6927，成员还包括其妻子Anna及其子女Irene、John、Ely和Mary，年龄分别约为14岁、11岁、6岁和3岁。

此外还有：Nicolas Georg Minescos，艺术家，出生于科孚岛，56岁，希腊国籍，持有希腊

Greek passport, issued by the Consular Department of the Greek
Legation at Moscow, on 21-9-26, No.563, comprising his wife
Anastasia, 35 years of age and his children Paolina, Bratien,
Leta, Lolias, resp. 12, 11, 10 and 8 years of age, which passport
has been extended by the Greek Consulate at Kobe for the last
time on 14-12-32 for a period of three months only; his brother
Elie Vladimir MINESCOS, an artist, born at Corfu, 26 years of
age, of Greek nationality, holder of a Greek passport, issued
also at Moscow on 21-9-26, No.566, comprising his wife Anne
Ivanovna, 30 years of age and his children Galina, Georges, Micha,
Mara, resp. 9, 7, 1 and 3 years of age, this passport having the
same extension; and Jean Mich. STANESCOS, a worker (a coppersmith
he said), born at Corfu, 60 years of age, of Greek nationality,
holder of a Greek passport, likewise issued at Moscow on 29-9-26,
No.575, comprising his wife Anna, who died since, and his children
Alexios, Grigories, Paoline (now supposed to be the wife of George
Pirez), Marie, Alexandra, Vassilios, resp. 20, 17, 18, 13, 9 and
8 years of age, this passport being extended for the last time at
Kobe on 8 Aug.1929 and valid till 8 Nov.1929.

They appear to be living all together at No.500 Rte de Sleyès,
house No.6.

The three Greeks stated that they came to Russia for the
first time about 1920 and that they left that country after a
stay of 8 years.

I have advised them not to proceed to Netherlands India be-
fore I have consulted the authorities at Batavia. With regard to
the two Pirez, it is to be noted that in their case no visé is
required, but of course the decision as to their admission rests
with the Netherlands Indian Immigration authorities. George Pirez
mentioned the possibility of going to Singapore where he thought
it might be more convenient to apply for permission to enter Nether-
lands India, Singapore being so much nearer to Batavia. I tried to
dissuade him from this plan.

I

希腊护照，由希腊驻莫斯科公使馆领事处于1926年9月21日签发，号码563，成员包括其妻子Anastasia，35岁，及其子女Paolina、Bratien、Leta、Lolias，年龄分别为12岁、11岁、10岁和8岁，该护照最后一次由希腊驻神户领事馆于1932年12月14日延期，仅延期三个月；其兄弟Elie Vladimir MINESCOS，艺术家，出生于科孚岛，26岁，希腊国籍，持有希腊护照，同样于1926年9月21日在莫斯科签发，号码566，成员包括其妻子Anne Ivanovna，30岁，及其子女Galina、Georges、Micha、Mara，年龄分别为9岁、7岁、1岁和3岁，该护照享有同样的延期；以及Jean Mich. STANESCOS，工人（他说是铜匠），出生于科孚岛，60岁，希腊国籍，持有希腊护照，同样于1926年9月29日在莫斯科签发，号码575，成员包括其妻子Anna（已故）及其子女Alexios、Grigories、Paoline（现据称为George Pirez的妻子）、Marie、Alexandra、Vassilios，年龄分别为20岁、17岁、18岁、13岁、9岁和8岁，该护照最后一次于1929年8月8日在神户延期，有效期至1929年11月8日。

他们似乎都共同居住在Sleyès路500号，6号房屋。

这三名希腊人表示，他们大约在1920年首次来到俄罗斯，并在停留8年后离开该国。

我已建议他们在我就此事咨询巴达维亚当局之前不要前往荷属印度。关于两名Pirez，需要注意的是，在他们这种情况下不需要签证，但当然，是否准许入境的决定权在于荷属印度移民当局。George Pirez提到了去新加坡的可能性，他认为在那里申请进入荷属印度的许可可能更方便，因为新加坡离巴达维亚近得多。我试图劝他放弃这个计划。

我
